title: Snow at the Airport - Winter season
content: Today, I roamed the airport, and saw that it was snowing outside. I could see the snow covered pinecone tree's and the tiny snowflakes falling out of the sky. It was pretty. There was a bathroom near the terminal I was at, but it looked like gas station work on the inside of one of the open stalls. I've never come across a dirty bathroom until I saw this one. It wasn't disgusting, it just looked like someone was fighting the toilet paper in one of the stalls. My friend, who I was there with, was crying laughing watching me try and find a useable stall. The airport itself was filled with people. Some were rushing to catch their flights. Others were sitting in the waiting areas. The lights were off near the waiting areas, but it made sense, I saw a few people sleeping. I overheard a conversation between these two ladies about dying. One of the ladies complained about how she hated dying, and the other was talking about how dumb the whole thing was or something. That's when It became clear that I was in the airport portion. The airport itself was actually nicely built, everything worked as intended, even the escalators. Surprisingly, the creepy police didn't come and harass me while I was there. However, I did run into them when I was roaming the school, they were harassing me there, then kinda eased off when I started being nonchalant towards them. But, yeah. It's snowing at the airport right now.
